channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Pakistan, Bangladesh among 10 worst hunger-hit countries: Which other nations are on the list?
item.description: Pakistan and Bangladesh are among the 10 worst hunger-hit countries globally, according to Action Against Hunger. Nigeria, DR Congo, Sudan, Yemen, Afghanistan, Myanmar, South Sudan and Syria are also on the list. Acute hunger affects around 266 million people across 47 countries.

item.title: FDA crackdown: FIR against Reliance Consumer Products, Reliance Retail, Blinkit, Zomato Hyperpure officials; here's why
item.description: The Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has seized food products worth ₹48 lakh during a crackdown across Thane and Pune districts. Licenses of five establishments have been suspended.

item.title: Dubai-bound Emirates flight delayed at Delhi airport after a bird strike | Watch video
item.description: An Emirates flight from Delhi to Dubai was delayed Friday after a bird strike affected its departure schedule.

item.title: Air India, Air India Express extend Saudi Arabia flight suspension until Oct 24 amid Houthi strikes: What airline said
item.description: Air India and Air India Express have suspended flights to Jeddah, Riyadh and Dammam until October 24 amid security concerns in West Asia following Houthi revel strikes. IndiGo on Thursday also extended the suspension of its flights to Saudi Arabian destinations until October 24.

item.title: Delhi Traffic Update: CR Park, GK-2 traffic curbs from 4 pm Saturday to midnight till October 20; check alternatives
item.description: Delhi Traffic Police has warned of possible congestion on eight major roads in South Delhi amid Durga Puja celebrations in Chittaranjan Park and Greater Kailash-2. Restrictions will remain in place from 4 pm to midnight daily until October 20.&nbsp;

item.title: Iran says supertanker carrying 2 million barrels of crude ablaze after hitting naval mine in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran’s IRGC Navy said a supertanker carrying over 2 million barrels of crude oil caught fire after hitting a naval mine while crossing the Strait of Hormuz via an unauthorised route. The incident comes amid rising attacks on shipping and Tehran’s tightening grip on the strategic waterway.

item.title: FSSAI notifies draft amendment to tighten infant nutrition rules: What are the changes being proposed?
item.description: FSSAI has proposed banning the addition of sucrose and fructose to infant nutrition products for babies up to six months old. The draft amendment is open for public feedback for 60 days before the regulator considers finalising it.

item.title: Shankar Mahadevan’s new Delhi restaurant Malgudi: Location, menu and what diners can expect
item.description: Singer-composer Shankar Mahadevan has opened Malgudi’s first Delhi outlet in Rajouri Garden. The vegetarian restaurant serves traditional South Indian dishes alongside fusion options, regional specialities and inventive coffee.&nbsp;

item.title: SC says internet access is a fundamental right, rejects blanket ban for children: ‘Safety and freedom are not at odds’
item.description: The Supreme Court ruled that children, like all individuals, have a fundamental right to access and use the internet.

item.title: Who is Natasha Narwal? 2020 Delhi riots case accused to travel to the UK for academic purposes
item.description: The Delhi High Court has allowed activist Natasha Narwal, who is out on bail in the 2020 Delhi riots conspiracy case, to visit the UK for academic work. A founding member of Pinjra Tod, she must return to India, refrain from seeking asylum and surrender her passport within 48 hours of returning.

item.title: How California ultra-rich prepare to fight against proposed ‘world’s first billionaire tax’
item.description: Tech billionaires have reportedly raised more than $340 million to defeat 'Proposition 40', a one-time 5 percent wealth tax that will fund healthcare and education.

item.title: ‘Relationship goals’: Chinese bride gifts ASUS ROG Astral RTX 5090 GPU; groom cries | Old video goes viral
item.description: An older video has resurfaced and is once again taking social media by storm, showing a bride surprising her newlywed husband with a highly coveted ASUS ROG Astral RTX 5090 graphics card on their wedding day.

item.title: Global Hunger Index 2026: Pakistan ranks 106th out of 122, reports one of the poorest performances in South Asia
item.description: Pakistan ranked 106th of 122 countries in the 2026 Global Hunger Index, with a score of 25.5 indicating serious hunger. Economic hardship, rising food prices and climate shocks have strained food security, while undernourishment and child wasting have worsened since 2018.

item.title: Why Republicans’ $1 billion election war chest is failing to translate into votes in the US midterms | Explained
item.description: Republicans have spent heavily on midterm races, backed by a nearly $1 billion war chest and major donations from Elon Musk, but their financial edge has not shifted polling or delivered proportionate advertising exposure.&nbsp;

item.title: Vedanta boss Anil Agarwal on Elon Musk unveiling flying car: ‘We saw these in science fiction movies and books’
item.description: Musk’s redesigned Tesla Roadster, developed in collaboration with SpaceX, demonstrated the electric sports car performing aerial manoeuvres using rocket-style thrusters.

item.title: Dhruv Rathee calls for protest at London’s Parliament Square — ‘Time world sees reality of vote chor’
item.description: The call for this international demonstration comes amid the escalating political turmoil in New Delhi, where opposition parties and civil rights groups have been protesting over alleged irregularities in the SIR of electoral rolls, marked by demands for the resignation of CEC Gyanesh Kumar

item.title: Trump waives key sanctions on Russian oil, invokes Section 115 of the Graham Act: Here's what it means for India
item.description: US President Donald Trump on Friday (local time) signed an executive order waiving key Russia-related sanctions and tariffs under the Graham Act, telling Congress that the decision was in the national interest.

item.title: Jaishankar ‘summoned’ by Marco Rubio? MEA clarifies Mumbai meet amid Congress criticism; says energy, trade on agenda
item.description: MEA spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said that External Affairs Minister Jaishankar will host the Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister of the UAE Sheikh Abdullah bin Zayed Al Nahyan, in Mumbai on October 19 and 20, 2026.

item.title: US-Iran war: Trump says Washington is weighing striking Pickaxe Mountain in Tehran, rejects use of ground troops
item.description: US President Donald Trump suggested the US could strike Iran’s Pickaxe Mountain nuclear site and dismissed the need for ground troops. He said the war would end soon, as reports indicated he was weighing the use of the “mother of all bombs” if combat resumes.

item.title: Bank holiday today, October 17: Are SBI, HDFC Bank, and other banks closed on Saturday, Maha Saptami?
item.description: Banks are open in most of India on October 17, 2026, the month’s third Saturday, but branches in Tripura are closed for Maha Saptami. October also includes nationwide and regional bank holidays for festivals and observances.

item.title: Petrol and diesel prices today, October 17: Check fuel cost in Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru
item.description: US President Donald Trump has issued a waiver of sanctions, restrictions, and duties under the Sanctions on Russia and Iran Act, citing national interest.

item.title: Oregon school shooting: Bend police identify 16-year-old special needs student as shooter; probe underway to find motive
item.description: Police identified 16-year-old Griffin J. John II as the shooter who killed three children and a teacher at Silver Rail Elementary in Bend, Oregon. A parent shot him dead inside the school.

item.title: Was White House behind Ukraine's Starlink, Starshield restriction? Trump breaks silence, says ‘it wasn’t me’ or Musk
item.description: US President Donald Trump's remarks came days after Ukrainian officials said SpaceX had restricted use of Starshield, a military-grade version of Starlink, without warning, impeding some military operations and its ability to defend civilians against intensifying attacks by Russia.

item.title: Avaada plans ₹40,000 crore capex for green ammonia, methanol plants
item.description: The manufacturing push comes ahead of a proposed ₹7,600 crore initial public offering of Avaada’s solar module manufacturing arm, Avaada Electro, planned for the end of this year.

item.title: Southern California Fire Burns Structures as Winds Intensify
item.description: A fast-moving wildfire in Orange County burned structures and forced evacuations Friday as powerful Santa Ana winds fueled a growing outbreak of fires across Southern California.

item.title: Malibu Fire Has Crews Racing Dryness, Fierce Santa Ana Winds
item.description: At least one firefighter has been injured and hundreds more are scrambling to contain a Malibu wildfire before dangerous winds ramp up again Friday.

item.title: Meet the 17-year-old scientist engineering tomatoes to taste like meat, and why her experiment could matter
item.description: Gabriella Rothberg, a 17-year-old student from Miami, is developing genetically engineered tomatoes designed to produce heme, a molecule associated with meat flavour. Her project could have nutritional applications, but its taste and health benefits remain unproven.

item.title: Pope Leo XIV celebrates Mass in hospital in first photos released since surgery
item.description: The Vatican on Friday released the first picture of Pope Leo XIV following his surgery, as the Pontiff attended Mass at Rome's Gemelli Hospital and doctors reported a steady improvement in his overall health condition.
